ngaap.notes: Vulcan's EBITDA bridge starts at net earnings (2021 Q3+: net earnings attributable to Vulcan) and adds back income tax, interest expense and the loss (earnings) on discontinued operations NET OF TAX before DDA&A, so published EBITDA is continuing-ops EBITDA; the schema check ni_vulcan+ebitda_bridge_tax+interest+total_dda=ebitda_pub therefore differs by ebitda_bridge_disc_ops (extra field, value as added); including it the check ties. adj_items.disc_ops is null (disc ops is not an EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA item). Adjusted EPS bridge: 'Items included in Adjusted EBITDA above' is the after-tax per-share effect of all EBITDA adjustments. Business development = non-routine acquisition charges incl. purchase-accounting inventory step-up -> adj_items.acquisition; COVID-19 direct incremental costs -> adj_items.other. FY2021: gain on sale of real estate 114.7; NOL valuation allowance +0.10 (discrete tax); acquisition financing interest +0.05 (in eps_items_after_tax_ps). Business development 39.0 incl. USCR acquisition related expenses 22.0 and inventory step-up 10.7. ROIC 14.2%. Same-store Aggregates (ex-USCR) cash GP/ton 7.48.
